column1: # The build register. One row per image produced; the schema and the reasoning
# are docs/project/BUILDS.md, and tools/builds.sh is what writes and validates
# It holds no rows. Every one of the twelve it held was removed at the project
# owner's direction on 2026-09-13, together with every archived image, and
# nothing is recorded here again until `Oxys 1 Alpha` — which docs/project/PLAN.md
# fixes at sub-task 8.7. The machinery is untouched: `make build-record` still
# works and would append row 1 the moment it is run.
# **Numbering restarts at 1**, by the owner's decision. A number issued before
# the clearing and a number issued after it are therefore different images, and
# what tells them apart is the date in the row — not the number. Every document
# that cited a number as a way of pointing at an image has stopped doing so;
# docs/project/TESTING-RECORD.md, which is an account of runs and is not edited
# after the fact, says so at its head.

column13: note
Oxys 1 Alpha: the release image, cut at the close of Phase 8; booted under QEMU by make verify and under VirtualBox at the keyboard
The register's policy: every build recorded from now on; the image this documentation change was verified with

The appearance of 2026-09-21 and the terminal livelock fixed with it, from a working tree in progress. The note was written by a mistyped `record --help`, which the script took for a note; it is corrected and the row kept, the image and its verdict being real.
The shell taken out of the launcher; the first image whose launcher offers only what has a window
The desktop drawing its accent from art/palette.h, named from /etc/desktop.conf by the word system
The demonstration's window drawing the mark of art/logo.h, and the archive check reporting rather than failing where the archive is not
The screen handed back to the console before the reason is written, and cleared when it is
Sub-task 9.6: the terminal emulator, the poll it waits in, and the tcgroup refusal
The terminal white upon black, and the fg that continued nothing
Icons for the launcher, read from files rather than compiled in
Negative test of the smooth mark and icons: the version-1 icon shipped and a logo byte with ink beyond coverage; both self-tests failed as intended, reverted
The mark and the icons at the resolution they are shown at: logo coverage table of 192, icon format version 2 at 48. Dirty only by the register's own uncommitted row 11; the source is exactly 7f1c530
A background upon the system's own filesystem, and windows that minimise and fill the screen
Negative test of the background and window states: the run-crossing check removed, the root notice not coalesced, a minimised window focusable; all caught, reverted
Sub-task 9.7: the file manager, the text viewer and the clock
Negative test of 9.7: the 12-hour reduction removed, gmtime's weekday from Wednesday, fork copying the alarm; all caught, reverted
The persistent /etc: a labelled volume mounted over the ramdisk's
Negative test of the persistent /etc: label prefix accepted, seeding truncating, no write-back on close; all caught, reverted
clear in a terminal window: the grid acts upon the form feed
Negative test of clear: the grid's form-feed case disabled; caught, reverted
A write of nothing returns zero, and micro saves files with blank lines
Negative test: meant to refuse a write of nothing again, the sed disabled all four length-zero tests of syscall.c (write, read, version, path canonicalisation); caught, reverted
The launcher offers the terminal when the file offers nothing; window create and destroy wake the session
Settings recoverable without knowing how, and seen without a restart
Negative test: defaults unstaged, micro's file beside left, no write-back after unlink; all caught, reverted
